title: Restore saved evaluator advice in existing ranking views
final_head_binding: Canonical handoff binds the exact final PR head containing this manifest via REVIEW_HEAD_SHA.

sanitized_source_input.observed_defect: QuarterlyRanking and PersonaLeague gated ProposalCell on r.recommendation / r.recommendedAction and fell back to fabricated no_change, hiding saved owner recommendations (e.g. promote_to_canary_candidate) and rationale when the ranking DTO legitimately omitted recommendation after heuristic removal.

acceptance_verification.AC1_saved_owner_recommendation_projectio: Updated useSavedProposals and ProposalCell in QuarterlyRanking.tsx and wired both QuarterlyRanking.tsx and PersonaLeague.tsx to project the saved owner recommendation action_id when the ranking/league DTO row omits recommendation, without regenerating advice from scores or falling back to fabricated no_change.
acceptance_verification.AC2_shared_consumers_rationale_source_id: Both QuarterlyRanking and PersonaLeague render the saved owner action, readable rationale, and source identity (evaluator_run_id and ranking_snapshot_id) for the same persona and quarter while preserving ranking scores and formulas as read-only evidence. Explicit actual no_change renders No change; missing or failed saved-owner reads render '—' without claiming a model conclusion. Preserves existing useV5Live AbortSignal and cacheKey boundaries.
acceptance_verification.AC3_governance_decision_and_advisory_rea: ProposalCell links to /management/human-inbox/approval:<decision_id> only when a genuine pending owner_decision.decision_id exists for a governed action, keeps terminal decisions (approved, approved_with_conditions, rejected, unavailable) read-only, and renders advisory reports (such as promote_to_canary_candidate with owner_decision: null) as non-executable read-only text without submit/vote/lifecycle/capital controls.
acceptance_verification.AC4_focused_test_suites_and_typecheck: Extended RankingRecommendationPages.test.tsx and LiveOnlyFallbacks.test.tsx with actual-schema ranking rows lacking recommendation and separate saved owner action/rationale/source identity, verifying read-only advisory projection on both views, truthful fallback on missing/failed owner reads, and preserved pending/terminal owner decision behavior. Ran both focused Vitest suites plus tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.agora.json typechecks.
acceptance_verification.AC5_scope_budget_and_worker_boundary: Touched only the 5 declared paths on a clean worktree branched from dev e0e50f914df200f0b192b07a11a9d4ed12788c54. Production net diff is +41 lines (<= 80 budget) and this manifest is 83 lines (<= 400 budget). No VM, SSH, product login, real provider, or hosted business actions were executed.
